name: Darkend
storyline:
- Mod Description -

Travel to the new island of Pharos, explore detailed environments, fight new enemies and discover an Ancient set of weapons of incredible power.
No quest, no holding hand.

Important: This mod is heavily inspired by The Demon's/Dark Souls games, which's I'm a fan of, so I designed the mod as a solo experience, so I recommend that you leave your followers behind, and a level 15 and up char is also recommended.

- How to start -

Travel to Voyager's end, the final resting place of a foreign ship, wrecked long ago on the Sea of Ghost, Northwest of Winterhold.
